name: comment_edit
description: Change a comment's text, colour, opacity, line width, rectangle (rectangle/oval/text box) or position (`move` [dx, dy] in points). One undo step.

color.description: #RRGGBB or a name: yellow, red, orange, green, blue, purple, pink, black, gray, white.

doc.description: Document id from doc_open or doc_list.

index.description: 1-based position on the page, as comment_list reports.

move.description: [x, y] in points from the top-left of the displayed page.
